search_text: published ZDI-17-157 ZDI-CAN-4366 Trend Micro Deep Discovery Email Inspector network_dump Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-03-09 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Trend Micro'] ['Deep Discovery Email Inspector'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Deep Discovery Email Inspector. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within network_dump.php. title: Trend Micro Deep Discovery Email Inspector network_dump Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Deep Discovery Email Inspector. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within network_dump.php. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of root.
